title: Example indie pop music video
style_bible: Indie pop music video, warm golden-hour palette, shallow depth of field, photoreal singer, cinematic B-roll inserts. 16:9 single subject one frame on performance stills.

cast.name: Maya
cast.cast_descriptor: woman indie singer, South Asian, mid 20s, warm expressive eyes

music.prompt: Indie pop, uplifting, warm female vocal, 92 BPM, acoustic guitar and soft synth pads, wide soundstage, crisp modern production, anthemic chorus

lyrics:
[Intro]
(Soft piano, building slowly)

[Verse]
We built the skills library line by line
Every workflow ready when you need it
From stills to motion, all in one place

[Pre Chorus]
And when the chorus hits you'll know

[Chorus]
Run the pipeline, watch it grow
Pruna models, let them flow

[Inst]
(Guitar and pads — instrumental break)

[Verse]
Copy paste curl and poll until it's done
Slider renders when the pairs are ready

[Chorus]
Run the pipeline, watch it grow
Pruna models, let them flow

[Outro]
(Fading)
Like the northern lights
